tasks.answer: Use ConfirmationDialog: pass the delete trigger as triggerButton, the mutating Button as confirmButton, and the question as title (optional body/icon='danger'/isDone). The catalog also ships a ready-made module-scoped wrapper discussions.DeleteDiscussion (required prop: id, admin-gated) used by the discussions table.

The login form uses Input; it binds react-hook-form through the required `registration` prop — spread the result of useForm's register('email')/register('password') (type Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>) — and label/error come from FieldWrapper, so it must sit inside <Form>.

Table pagination is handled by TablePagination, which needs totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl and builds rootUrl?page=N links (rootUrl must have no query string). Table also accepts an optional `pagination` prop of type TablePaginationProps, and DiscussionsList reads `page` from URL search params.
Use MDPreview; it takes the Markdown source string in a single required `value` prop (default ''), parses it and sanitizes the HTML with DOMPurify — do not pass pre-rendered HTML.
CreateDiscussion is an admin-only drawer form (title + Markdown body). It requires the Authorization provider and checks admin permission — only admins see the trigger; it takes no props.

notes: Catalog-only run: 12 searches + 11 gets (log /tmp/audit-b4/usage/catalog-1.jsonl), no project source files read, no files modified. Catalog is fresh (single sourceDigest across all responses). Task 1: chose the generic ConfirmationDialog because a confirmation dialog with plural required props is asked; the catalog's alternative is the feature wrapper discussions.DeleteDiscussion (module-scoped to discussions, requires id), which already composes an admin-gated delete control. Task 3: TablePagination is the reusable control; Table consumes it via its optional pagination prop.
